prompt: Nora fixes the streetlamp before dark
title: Bright Streetlamp
irony: Nora the fixer who never switches off only lights the street when she stops fixing and enjoys it with Teddy.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Teddy and Benny watch the grey streetlamp at dusk on the quiet street.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy wants a bug hunt under the lamp but corrects Nora about bulbs.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Knox kicks his ball, smacks the lamp, and the lamp stays dark before night.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids chant for the bright streetlamp as shadows stretch across the street.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Nora climbs with her doctor bag and Teddy lists voltage facts while the bulb stays dark.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Knox dares a shake, twists the shade loose, and feathers puff over Nora.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids chant for the bright streetlamp again as the sky turns purple.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Nora holds her tools and admits fixing cannot beat the dark alone.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Nora puts the tools down and invites Teddy to watch for first stars with her.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Nora sings the lamp alight as Teddy holds the ladder and the street glows gold.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The lamp glows over bug jars while Nora hugs Teddy and Knox shares his ball.
